An E-commerce VA Who Keeps Your Store Running Smoothly

Where I come from

02 — Store Operations
The SEO Audit Spreadsheet Built for Storefronts

A clean storefront hides the tracking underneath it. This is the format I use to catch what the theme editor won't show you — missing meta descriptions, thin alt text, pricing that's drifted from the source.

50+ SKUs tracked · 100% meta coverage
03 — Visual Merchandising · Sample work
Raw Product Photo → A+ Listing Image

A phone photo on a kitchen counter doesn't earn a click. An AI-assisted enhancement pass, plus Canva and TinyIMG for cropping, color correction, and on-brand framing, is usually the difference between "looks homemade" and "looks like a real brand."

Lessons Learned

Building OBARISTO reinforced something simple: most Shopify performance problems come down to a handful of avoidable habits — bloated apps, uncompressed images, unstructured metadata. Fix those first, before you touch the redesign.

Future Improvements

Next on the roadmap: a full blog content calendar for organic traffic, a loyalty and rewards flow, and structured A/B tests on hero banners and collection layouts.

FAQ

Do you have paid Shopify client experience?

Not yet on a Shopify store. My paid VA work so far was a one-month real estate contract, on top of customer service roles supporting US clients. For Shopify, what I have is focused training and OBARISTO — a complete demo store I built from scratch to prove I can do the work. I'm looking for the right first opportunity to bring that same care to a real brand.

What's your availability?

Open to part-time or full-time remote work, with typical response times under 24 hours.

Do you work across time zones?

Yes — happy to align working hours with your team, wherever you're based.

What tools do you use day to day?

Shopify admin, Klaviyo, Judge.me, DSers, TinyIMG, Google Analytics & Search Console, Semrush, plus AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to work faster.

Can you customize a Shopify theme?

Yes, for lighter edits — layout tweaks, styling fixes, and small Liquid changes to match your brand without needing a full developer.
